It is designed for controlled warmth and flexible layering rather than full weather protection.

retail_productfeed.technical_summary: Mens TEMPO! Shield Zip Neck is a zoned hybrid running top for cool, windy and changeable weather. A windproof 3-layer front panel with a water-repellent finish protects the torso and has a soft brushed inner surface for added warmth. The close fit makes the top suitable both as an outer layer in milder weather and as a midlayer under a vest or jacket in winter.

The back and sleeves use a highly breathable, sweat-transporting stretch fabric that helps the body release excess heat. A mid-height collar and short front zipper make temperature regulation easy. The close fit makes the top suitable both as an outer layer in milder weather and as a midlayer under a vest or jacket in winter.

retail_productfeed.technical_summary: Womens TEMPO! PRO Top is a women's-specific performance top for endurance sports such as running, cycling and triathlon. A double front combines a ventilating inner layer with a supportive outer layer, while a technical fabric with ceramic yarn is selected with cooling comfort at high intensity in mind. The racerback construction leaves the shoulders free to move, and an integrated pocket for a radio or small essentials reflects input from professional cycling. The top can be used as a base layer, midlayer or on its own depending on the activity and support needed. PRO prioritises maximum performance and marginal gains.

Removing the front zipper creates a simpler construction with fewer potential pressure points. Three rear pockets provide space for nutrition and equipment, while an additional YKK zippered pocket can hold smaller valuables. A silicone gripper and 3M reflective details complete the practical design. The focus is comfort, durability and straightforward function across cycling disciplines.

retail_productfeed.technical_summary: Womens SLi Tri Suit is a sleeveless triathlon and duathlon suit focused on low weight, quick drying and freedom of movement. Water-repellent stretch fabrics help limit water uptake after the swim, while the supportive construction around the thighs provides a stable fit on both bike and run. Elastic leg endings with silicone help keep the suit in place, and a thin triathlon pad adds bike comfort without unnecessary bulk on the run. The sleeveless design leaves the shoulders completely free and is primarily intended for short-distance triathlon.

Two integrated nutrition pockets keep energy close to the body, while the elastic front YKK zipper allows ventilation. The back panel has also been tested to provide UPF 50+ sun protection. ONE keeps a clear race-performance focus while offering greater versatility than PRO.

retail_productfeed.technical_summary: TEMPO! PRO Trail T-Shirt is a technical running T-shirt for long trail sessions where heat, sun and repeated friction from a running vest need to be managed at the same time. A robust technical main fabric is used across the front, back and sleeves where the vest typically makes contact, while lighter, more ventilating side panels increase airflow in high-heat areas. Fabric placement is specifically adapted to the demands of trail running.

PRO Trail T-Shirt is a technical running T-shirt for long trail sessions where heat, sun and repeated friction from a running vest need to be managed at the same time. A robust technical main fabric is used across the front, back and sleeves where the vest typically makes contact, while lighter, more ventilating side panels increase airflow in high-heat areas. The shoulder seam is moved away from a typical vest pressure zone to reduce irritation, and the stretch construction follows the body over uneven terrain. Fabric placement is specifically adapted to the demands of trail running.

retail_productfeed.technical_summary: Mens S2 Run Jacket is a running jacket for cold conditions, using a hybrid construction to balance weather protection with ventilation and sweat transport. An elastic 3-layer laminate protects the front and shoulders, where wind and precipitation are most exposed, while the more breathable C3-based back helps the body release excess heat and sweat. The fit follows the body closely without feeling restrictive. A chest pocket, open rear pocket, YKK zipper and reflective details complete the running-specific design. S2 places protection where it is needed most rather than enclosing the entire body in a membrane.

retail_productfeed.technical_summary: Mens S1 Run Vest is a lightweight running vest for wind, light rain and changeable weather. The fit makes it easy to wear over a base layer or light midlayer. A robust YKK zipper with a wind-resistant storm flap, a zippered chest pocket and reflective details complete the functional design. It is intended as a simple outer layer where weather protection takes priority over insulation.

The fit makes it easy to wear over a base layer or light midlayer. A robust YKK zipper with a wind-resistant storm flap, a zippered chest pocket and reflective details complete the functional design. It is intended as a simple outer layer where weather protection takes priority over insulation.

retail_productfeed.technical_summary: Mens S2 Run Vest is a running vest for cold conditions, built around targeted protection rather than a full membrane around the body. The roomy fit leaves space for regular clothing underneath. A hood, extended back, practical pockets and extensive 3M reflective details support commuting use. The focus is weather protection, warmth and visibility for active transport and everyday use. It is also available in orange for increased visibility.
